name: medallion
note: 14 Medallion v002 (feedback 2026-11-12): the size of Final Blender/Perhaps_Select_Box.blend (outer 176.4 x 176.4 mm, 140 mm tall, measured from its Base and Lid shells), umber fine linen outside (textures/sources/designer_umber_linen), lighter umber suede collar, pad and lid lining, the official perhaps wordmark debossed tone-on-tone into the lid top with a softened rim, and a sharp flat rectangular champagne-gold clasp instead of the domed cushion. Form otherwise as v001: base and lid shells with a recessed collar band in the reveal, back-hinged lid, U notch and tab at the front centre, ring pad with one slit, Perhaps in gold on the lid lining.

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB (umber linen colour and normal swatch, lighter umber suede, champagne gold); renders swap in config/presets/box_medallion_v002_look.json.
